_meta.purpose: Machine-readable inventory of every setting autopilot reads: config.json keys, AUTOPILOT_* environment variables, the Claude Code settings it depends on, and project-level DI files. Checked in both directions by scripts/check-config-docs.js; the human reference for audience=user entries is docs/settings-reference.md.

fields.name: dotted path for a config key, the variable name for env/cc_setting, .claude/<file> for project_di
fields.class: internal only: test_seam | path_seam | plumbing | experiment_flag | probe_toggle | band_source_switch
fields.default: null when there is no default
fields.readers: files that read it; each must contain the needle
fields.needle: optional literal the reader must contain (default: env name or prefix, last dotted segment, template basename)
fields.prefix: env family: any token starting with it is covered
fields.relates: settings that depend on or override this one
fields.type: config_key only: boolean | number | string | array | object | enum, joined with | for alternatives; read by scripts/lib/config-audit.js
fields.allowed: config_key, type enum: the accepted values
fields.invalid_effect: config_key: what an out-of-range value does, quoted in the config-audit finding
fields.changed_in: config_key: list of {schema, from, to, note}. schema = the config_schema_version at which a default changed. Append one when you change a documented default; config-audit lists entries whose schema is above the user's config_schema_version (up to the current one). Bump CURRENT_SCHEMA in scripts/lib/config-audit.js when you add a schema number.

_meta.audience_rule: user = a human sets it to change what autopilot does (a documented knob with an effect they can observe). internal = autopilot sets it for its own child processes, it only redirects a path or injects a fault or clock for tests, or it is a maintainer/diagnostic switch. By name pattern, internal: AUTOPILOT_TEST_*, *_TEST_HOOK, *_FIXTURE, *_CRASH_AT, *_KILL_AFTER*, *_RACE_PATH, *_SEAMS, FAULT_INJECT*, *_NOW(_MS), *_SESSION_ID, *_RUN_ID, and path/binary overrides ending in _DIR/_FILE/_PATH/_BIN/_SH/_SCRIPT/_RESOLVER/_LEDGER/_RECEIPT/_INPUT/_ENV. Everything else is classified by hand and a user entry must appear in docs/settings-reference.md.
_meta.scan_rules: env: AUTOPILOT_[A-Z0-9_]+ in .js .ts .tsx .mjs .sh .py under bin/ hooks/ scripts/ src/ mods/, excluding tests/ dirs, *.test.*, test-*, run-tests.sh, fixtures/, node_modules/ and the platforms/ and .opencode mirrors. config: property reads with a snake_case key in files that mention config-path / AUTOPILOT_CONFIG_FILE / .autopilot/config.json (best effort; keys without an underscore are only checked in the reverse direction). di: every file in project-config-template/.

env.AUTOPILOT_HARNESS_OK: output sentinel printed by src/harness/capabilities.js, not an environment variable
env.AUTOPILOT_REVIEW_LEDGER_COPY_TEST_DELAY_: test-only delay seam in scripts/lib/review-ledger-copy.js; not a user knob. Honoured only with AUTOPILOT_TEST_ALLOW_REVIEW_LEDGER_COPY_DELAY=1
env.AUTOPILOT_TEST_ALLOW_REVIEW_LEDGER_COPY_: test-only gate for the review-ledger copy delay. Exactly 1 enables AUTOPILOT_REVIEW_LEDGER_COPY_TEST_DELAY_MS; not a user knob
env.AUTOPILOT_TEST_ALLOW_REVIEW_LEDGER_ARCHI: test-only gate for the review-ledger rotate clock. Exactly 1 enables AUTOPILOT_TEST_NOW; not a user knob
test-only gate for review-ledger prune --target. Exactly 1 enables the hidden flag; not a user knob
test-only gate for the review-ledger prune pause between validation and delete. Exactly 1 enables the ready/release files; not a user knob
env.AUTOPILOT_REVIEW_LEDGER_ARCHIVE_PRUNE_RE: test-only path the prune pause writes when it is waiting. Honoured only with AUTOPILOT_TEST_ALLOW_REVIEW_LEDGER_ARCHIVE_PRUNE_PAUSE=1
test-only path the prune pause waits for before deleting. Honoured only with AUTOPILOT_TEST_ALLOW_REVIEW_LEDGER_ARCHIVE_PRUNE_PAUSE=1

config.artifact_type: field of a qualification feed document, not an operator config key
config.baseline_event_id: field of a scorecard event, not an operator config key
config.event_id: field of a scorecard/feed event, not an operator config key
config.local_is_official_default: field of a qualification feed row, not an operator config key
config.transcript_hash: field of a qualification feed row, not an operator config key

templates.hooks.json: placeholder template: nothing in the repo reads a project-level .claude/hooks.json, so there is no setting to register

entries.name: autoCompactEnabled
entries.summary: Claude Code setting (settings.json, else ~/.claude.json): false turns auto-compact off.

entries.name: autoCompactWindow
entries.summary: Claude Code setting (user/project/local/policy settings.json; also modelSettings.<model>.autoCompactWindow): token window after which Claude Code compacts, at window minus a 33k buffer. Set via /autocompact or in settings.json.

entries.name: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW
entries.summary: Claude Code environment variable: auto-compact window in tokens (clamped to 100000-1000000). Beats every settings file.

entries.name: DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT
entries.summary: Claude Code environment variable: 1, true, yes or on turns auto-compact off.

entries.name: DISABLE_COMPACT
entries.summary: Claude Code environment variable: 1, true, yes or on turns all compaction off.

entries.name: <ENV_NAME>
entries.note: config.json may carry {"<ENV_NAME>": "off"} for the knobs of the live band sources; only the band source manifest reads these, the hooks themselves honor the environment variable and their own keys.

entries.name: advisory_bridge.<hook>
entries.summary: Per-hook override of advisory_bridge.mode; <hook> is cost_tracker, version_drift, context_budget or suggest_compact.

entries.name: advisory_bridge.mode
entries.summary: Where hook advisories go: "sink" shows them as a band toast (default); "inject" puts them in the model context as before.

entries.name: context_budget.gap
entries.summary: Tokens between the T2 reminder and the point where Claude Code compacts; used by the SessionStart check that T2 can fire before compaction.

entries.name: context_budget.live_write
entries.summary: false stops the hook writing the live context file the status band reads (the reminders keep firing).

entries.name: context_budget.mode
entries.summary: "off" silences the context-budget reminders and the SessionStart window check; "warn" keeps them.
entries.invalid_effect: anything but off or warn is ignored, so the reminders stay on

entries.name: context_budget.per_model
entries.summary: Per-model t1/t2 keyed by a model-id glob (matched against the statusline live file's model.id; the pattern with the most literal characters wins; no match uses the top-level tiers).
entries.invalid_effect: keys other than t1 and t2, and values that are not positive integers, are ignored with a one-line warning

entries.name: context_budget.post_compact_warn
entries.summary: After compaction, one advisory when the live context still exceeds this many tokens. 0 disables. A value that is not an integer >= 0 is ignored, so with nothing valid set the threshold stays 100000. Advisory only.
entries.invalid_effect: a value that is not an integer >= 0 is ignored, so with nothing valid set the threshold stays 100000

entries.name: context_budget.seat
entries.summary: session (default) keeps the T2 handoff wording. resident tells a fixed-address seat to update its state file and keep only that path and the unfinished items after compaction. Anything else is ignored.
entries.invalid_effect: anything but session or resident is ignored, so the seat stays session

entries.name: context_budget.step
entries.summary: A tier repeats its reminder only after the context grew by this many tokens since it last fired; 0 reminds on every call past the threshold.

entries.name: context_budget.t1
entries.summary: Context size (tokens) at which the first reminder fires: plan a checkpoint and avoid loading large files inline.

entries.name: context_budget.t2
entries.summary: Context size (tokens) of the second, stronger reminder: write a handoff. With auto-compact configured it is only a reminder; without it the hook tells you to stop and /clear.

entries.name: cost_fuse.daily_usd_brain
entries.summary: Daily USD cap on top-tier (brain) model spend, summed per UTC day from the cost ledger.

entries.name: cost_fuse.mode
entries.summary: What the daily brain-spend fuse does at the cap: "warn" (default), "block" or "off".

entries.name: cost_fuse.tiers
entries.summary: Which model tiers count toward the cap.

entries.name: cost_tracker.cache_read_warn_tokens
entries.summary: Cumulative cache-read tokens in one session at which the tracker prints its first warning (then at each doubling).

entries.name: cost_tracker.context_clear_pct
entries.summary: Window fill (percent) at or above which the cost warning recommends a handoff and /clear.

entries.name: depth0_delegate_gate.guarded_models
entries.summary: Model families the gate applies to.

entries.name: depth0_delegate_gate.mode
entries.summary: Reminder when the top-level session fires many read-class calls in a row: "off", "warn" or "block".

entries.name: depth0_delegate_gate.pkill_self_match
entries.summary: What to do with a pkill/pgrep -f pattern that would match its own command line: "deny", "warn" or "off".

entries.name: depth0_delegate_gate.threshold
entries.summary: Consecutive read-class calls before the delegate reminder.

entries.name: depth0_delegate_gate.wait_advice_every
entries.summary: Repeat interval of the foreground-wait advice.

entries.name: dirty_tree_reminder
entries.summary: false switches the dirty-working-tree reminder off; an object sets min_files, min_lines and interval_minutes.

entries.name: dirty_tree_reminder.interval_minutes
entries.summary: Minimum minutes between two reminders per repo and session; 0 reminds every turn.

entries.name: dirty_tree_reminder.min_files
entries.summary: Changed files that trigger the reminder.

entries.name: dirty_tree_reminder.min_lines
entries.summary: Changed lines that trigger the reminder.

entries.name: owner_question_guard
entries.summary: false switches off the Stop guard that blocks a reply waiting for the owner without a decision card id.

entries.name: subagent_budget.mode
entries.summary: Subagent budget gate on Agent dispatch: "remind" (deny at a ceiling), "warn" (note, never deny) or "off".

entries.name: subagent_budget.lane_dispatch_max
entries.summary: Dispatches one lane may already have before the next is denied (reviewers excluded).

entries.name: subagent_budget.lane_turns_max
entries.summary: Subagent turns one lane may already have used before the next dispatch is denied.

entries.name: subagent_budget.root_turns_per_hour_max
entries.summary: Subagent turns of the whole session in the last 60 minutes before the next dispatch is denied.

entries.name: subagent_budget.concurrent_advise_max
entries.summary: Running subagents at or above this number add one advisory line on Agent dispatch. 0 disables the line. The hook never denies on this count.

entries.name: foreman_guard.advisory_every
entries.summary: Repeat interval of the non-denying advisory for other Engine-header subagents.

entries.name: foreman_guard.bash_cap
entries.summary: Bash calls a foreman may make before it is told to hand off.

entries.name: foreman_guard.mode
entries.summary: Foreman guard (Bash cap, no-polling, no-Monitor for l4-l6 subagents): "block", "warn" or "off".

entries.name: foreman_guard.reserve_calls
entries.summary: Calls held back after the cap for the closing handoff (git status, add, commit, ...).

entries.name: foreman_guard.role_caps
entries.summary: Per-role Bash caps: an object with foreman, worker and reviewer integers (worker and reviewer default to 120).

entries.name: handoff_inject
entries.summary: true restores the machine session snapshot after /clear (session-handoff + session-start hooks).

entries.name: hooks.<stem>
entries.default: opt-in hooks off, default-on hooks on
entries.summary: Per-hook switch. true enables an opt-in hook; false disables a default-on hook that honors it (residue-auto-reap).

changed_in.to: on (default-on hooks: context-budget, dispatch-model-guard, cost-tracker, foreman-guard; v2.35.15)
changed_in.note: These hooks used to be opt-in. A hook you never enabled now runs; the exit knob is in the Hook switches section of docs/settings-reference.md.

entries.name: orchestrator_edit_gate.mode
entries.summary: What the (opt-in) orchestrator-edit-gate does when the top-level session edits files itself: "warn", "block" or "off".

entries.name: qualification_feed.url
entries.summary: Default feed URL for adopt-qualification-defaults.js --from; it never fetches by itself.

entries.name: qualification_feed.trust
entries.summary: How a gate-passed qualification feed is used: auto (default), confirm, or off. An unrecognised value is off.

entries.name: qualification_outbox.enqueue
entries.summary: When true, a completed engine-scorecard record is also queued in the registry outbox (~/.autopilot/qualification-outbox). The local scorecard write is unchanged; nothing is sent until flush runs with a transport.

entries.name: qualification_outbox.transport
entries.summary: How qualification-send-queue.js flush sends: off (nothing is sent) or git (bot branch + pull request in the registry clone; the owner merges, the merge is the ack).
entries.invalid_effect: any other value is treated as off

entries.name: qualification_outbox.registry_repo
entries.summary: Path of the dedicated bot clone of the registry repo (llm-playground) used by the git transport. Required when transport is git.

entries.name: qualification_outbox.workspace
entries.summary: Registry workspace (benchmarks/qualification/<workspace>) the outbox sends into.

entries.name: residue.archive_branch_days
entries.summary: Days before an archive branch is cleaned up.

entries.name: residue.archive_remind_days
entries.summary: Age in days after which an old archive ref is only listed as needing a human, never deleted.

entries.name: residue.auto_reap
entries.summary: Automatic reaping of finished dispatch worktrees and branches.

entries.name: residue.branch_prefixes
entries.summary: Extra branch prefixes the reaper treats as dispatch branches (letters, digits, . _ - and an optional trailing /).

entries.name: run_ledger.max_rotations
entries.summary: How many rotated run-ledger segments are kept (default 4). Readers follow segments .N down to .1 then the live ledger. At 0 the campaign CLI and run-ledger.sh read only the live ledger, but the seat-store, work-order and engine readers fall back to 4; the writer still moves the live ledger to .1 on rotation even at 0. Each reader keeps its own rule for odd values: work-order and engine accept only integers 1 to 64 (else 4); seat-store and the campaign CLI cut 1.5 down to 1, use 4 for negatives and keep values above 64; the shell script uses the number as given. Config only: the RUN_LEDGER_MAX_ROTATIONS environment variable is not read.

entries.name: residue.lease_hours
entries.summary: Hours a dispatch worktree is kept before it may be reaped.

entries.name: residue.tmp_prune
entries.summary: Daily host-wide prune of autopilot temp roots, riding on the automatic reap.

entries.name: review_ledger_archive.dir
entries.summary: Directory for the opt-in review-ledger archive. Unset or empty means off: it writes nothing. The config file is still read to learn whether the key is set. The environment variable wins.
entries.invalid_effect: a non-string is an error at copy time; empty string means off

entries.name: review_ledger_archive.include_diff
entries.summary: When true, the archive copy also stores diff.txt. Default false.
entries.invalid_effect: anything but a boolean (or env true/false/1/0/yes/no) is ignored, so diff.txt stays out

entries.name: review_ledger_archive.warn_mb
entries.summary: status warns when the archive is larger than this many mebibytes. Never blocks.
entries.invalid_effect: a value that is not a number >= 0 is ignored, so the threshold stays 500

entries.name: review_ledger_archive.rotate_after_months
entries.summary: rotate compresses complete month directories strictly older than this many calendar months. The current month is never compressed.
entries.invalid_effect: a value that is not a positive integer is ignored, so the age stays 2

entries.name: review_ledger_archive.rotate_remove_source
entries.summary: When true, rotate deletes the month directory after the tar listing matches. Default false keeps the directory.
entries.invalid_effect: anything but a boolean (or env true/false/1/0/yes/no) is ignored, so the source stays

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_REVIEW_LEDGER_ARCHIVE_DIR
entries.summary: Overrides review_ledger_archive.dir. Empty string means off.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_REVIEW_LEDGER_ARCHIVE_INCLUDE_DIFF
entries.summary: Overrides review_ledger_archive.include_diff. true, 1, or yes copies diff.txt.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_REVIEW_LEDGER_ARCHIVE_WARN_MB
entries.summary: Overrides review_ledger_archive.warn_mb.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_REVIEW_LEDGER_ARCHIVE_ROTATE_AFTER_MONTHS
entries.summary: Overrides review_ledger_archive.rotate_after_months. A non positive integer is ignored.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_REVIEW_LEDGER_ARCHIVE_ROTATE_REMOVE_SOURCE
entries.summary: Overrides review_ledger_archive.rotate_remove_source. true, 1, or yes deletes the month directory after a matched listing.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_REVIEW_LEDGER_LOCK_STALE_MS
entries.note: Positive number replaces the 30000ms ledger-lock stale threshold. Tests only. Unset, zero, and non-numeric values keep 30000.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_REVIEW_LEDGER_REPO_ROOT
entries.note: Points a temp copy of review-ledger-copy.js at the repo. Tests only.

entries.name: review.port
entries.summary: Port of the local review page server (bound to 127.0.0.1 only). A busy port is reported, never replaced.

entries.name: run_approval.mode
entries.summary: Human approval gate on dispatches: "off" or "ask-once". An unattended (claude -p) run must keep it off.

entries.name: implementer_claude_native.confirmed_at
entries.summary: ISO timestamp of the owner's one-time confirmation that dispatch-hetero may use the first-party claude-native implementer runner. Written only by `node scripts/run-approval.js confirm-claude-native`; without it the runner is refused.

entries.name: topology.exclude_seats
entries.summary: Seats (engine/effort@runner, or a bare engine) never offered by the dispatch ladders and review panel; unioned with --exclude-seats.

entries.name: ui.locale
entries.summary: Language of the live band and pane: "en", "zh-TW" or "auto" (follow Claude Code).

entries.name: update_check
entries.summary: false stops the "Autopilot updated" notice at session start.

entries.name: prices_fetch
entries.summary: false stops the SessionStart refresh of the seat price cache (scripts/qualification-prices.js fetch).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_ADAPTIVE_INTERVENTION
entries.note: run-ledger.sh adaptive-intervention flag, default off; no operator documentation exists.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_RESIDUE_RECENT_HOURS
entries.note: Hours of recent on-disk activity that keep a clean worktree out of every removal path (default 24); 0 turns it off for fixtures that age nothing.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_AGY_STDIN_MAX_BYTES
entries.note: Fail-closed ceiling on the encoded agy stdin line (default 170000 bytes, BL-0021: agy's silent stdin wall is a deployment property). Raise only on a host where the tail-nonce probe was measured.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_AGY_INPUT_TOKEN_CEILING
entries.note: Response-side fail-closed ceiling on result.usage.input_tokens (default 95000; a non-positive-integer value falls back to the default). agy 1.4.6 silently drops the prompt tail near 97.6k input tokens (BL-0021), so a SUCCESS at or over it is refused as agy_input_truncated.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_FOREMAN_ASSET_ROOT
entries.summary: Test mode only (honoured when AUTOPILOT_QUALIFY_SEED is set). Points verifyPinnedForemanEvaluationAssets at a fixture tree instead of the repo evals pins. A non-test run that finds this key set exits 2; it is never silently ignored and does not redirect the exam.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_MERGE_CRASH_AFTER_EDGE
entries.summary: Test-only fault seam for merge crash simulation, honoured only when AUTOPILOT_TEST_SEAMS=1.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_TEST_SEAMS
entries.summary: Master switch for all test-only seams.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_ADVISORY_BRIDGE
entries.summary: inject or sink for all four advisory hooks at once.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_ADVISORY_BRIDGE_<HOOK>
entries.summary: inject or sink for one hook; <HOOK> is COST_TRACKER, VERSION_DRIFT, CONTEXT_BUDGET or SUGGEST_COMPACT. Beats the global variable.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_ADVISORY_RELAY
entries.summary: Set to "off" to stop the UserPromptSubmit hook that drains queued advisories into the next prompt.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_DECIDE_REPLY_CLOSE
entries.summary: Set to "off" to stop a live-panel reply whose first line is [待決回覆] from closing the decision cards it names.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_AGENT_ACTIVITY
entries.summary: Set to "off" to stop the subagent activity stamps.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_ALLOW_REAL_STORE_WITH_BIN_OVERRIDE
entries.summary: Set to "1" to let a dispatch whose --*-bin override is not the PATH binary write the real capability store. Otherwise the strike writer and passive capture skip that write unless ENGINE_CAPABILITY_DIR, ENGINE_CAPABILITY_FILE, or --store isolates it.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_ASK_DECISION
entries.summary: Set to "off" to stop recording AskUserQuestion prompts as decisions.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_AUTHOR_KILL_GRACE_SECS
entries.summary: Seconds the agy author runner is given after the outer timeout before it is killed. A positive integer; zero, negatives and non-numbers fall back to 30.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_AUTHOR_MAX_TOKENS
entries.summary: Response cap of an authoring dispatch.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_AWAITING_OWNER
entries.summary: Set to "off" to stop the awaiting-owner attention records the band shows.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_BASH_GUARD_PKILL_MODE
entries.summary: Environment override of depth0_delegate_gate.pkill_self_match; a garbage value maps to deny.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_CAPTURE_PAYLOAD
entries.summary: Set to "1" to write hook payloads to disk for debugging (scripts/toggle-payload-capture.js).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_CONFIG_FILE
entries.summary: Use this file instead of ~/.autopilot/config.json as the operator config.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_CONSULT_TIMEOUT
entries.summary: Timeout of a consult dispatch.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_CONTEXT_BUDGET_GAP
entries.summary: Environment override of context_budget.gap (number >= 0; beats the config).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_CONTEXT_BUDGET_LIVE_WRITE
entries.summary: off, 0 or false stops the live context file write.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_CONTEXT_BUDGET_MODE
entries.summary: Set to "off" to silence context-budget. Any other value is ignored (the config accepts "off" and "warn").

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_CONTEXT_BUDGET_POST_COMPACT_WARN
entries.summary: Environment override of context_budget.post_compact_warn (integer >= 0; 0 disables; beats the config). Any other value is ignored, so with nothing valid set the threshold stays 100000.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_CONTEXT_BUDGET_SEAT
entries.summary: Environment override of context_budget.seat (session or resident; beats the config). Any other value is ignored.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_CONTEXT_BUDGET_STEP
entries.summary: Environment override of context_budget.step (number >= 0; beats the config).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_CONTEXT_BUDGET_T1
entries.summary: Environment override of context_budget.t1 (positive number; beats the config).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_CONTEXT_BUDGET_T2
entries.summary: Environment override of context_budget.t2 (positive number; beats the config).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_CONTEXT_WINDOW_GATE
entries.summary: off, warn or block: what a dispatch does when its prompt would not fit the engine context window.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_COST_FUSE_DAILY_USD
entries.summary: Environment override of cost_fuse.daily_usd_brain (positive number).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_COST_FUSE_MODE
entries.summary: Environment override of cost_fuse.mode (block, warn or off).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_COST_TRACKER
entries.summary: Set to "false" to switch the cost tracker off.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_COST_TRACKER_CACHE_READ_WARN
entries.summary: Environment override of cost_tracker.cache_read_warn_tokens.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_COST_TRACKER_CLEAR_PCT
entries.summary: Environment override of cost_tracker.context_clear_pct.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_DEPTH0_DELEGATE_GATE_MODE
entries.summary: Environment override of depth0_delegate_gate.mode; a garbage value maps to warn.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_DEPTH0_WAIT_ADVICE_EVERY
entries.summary: Environment override of depth0_delegate_gate.wait_advice_every.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_DIRTY_TREE_INTERVAL_MINUTES
entries.summary: Environment override of dirty_tree_reminder.interval_minutes.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_DIRTY_TREE_MIN_FILES
entries.summary: Environment override of dirty_tree_reminder.min_files.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_DIRTY_TREE_MIN_LINES
entries.summary: Environment override of dirty_tree_reminder.min_lines.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_DIRTY_TREE_REMINDER
entries.summary: Set to false, 0, off or no to disable the dirty-tree reminder.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_OWNER_QUESTION_GUARD
entries.summary: Set to off, false, 0 or no to disable the owner-question guard.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_SUBAGENT_BUDGET_MODE
entries.summary: Environment override of subagent_budget.mode.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_SUBAGENT_BUDGET_LANE_DISPATCH_MAX
entries.summary: Environment override of subagent_budget.lane_dispatch_max.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_SUBAGENT_BUDGET_LANE_TURNS_MAX
entries.summary: Environment override of subagent_budget.lane_turns_max.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_SUBAGENT_BUDGET_ROOT_TURNS_PER_HOUR_MAX
entries.summary: Environment override of subagent_budget.root_turns_per_hour_max.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_SUBAGENT_BUDGET_CONCURRENT_ADVISE_MAX
entries.summary: Environment override of subagent_budget.concurrent_advise_max. 0 disables the advisory.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_SUBAGENT_BUDGET_NOW_MS
entries.note: Epoch-ms clock for hooks/subagent-budget.js; the hook suite injects it so the 60-minute window is deterministic. Honoured only when AUTOPILOT_TEST_ALLOW_SUBAGENT_BUDGET_CLOCK=1 is also set.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_TEST_ALLOW_SUBAGENT_BUDGET_CLOCK
entries.note: Set to 1 to let hooks/subagent-budget.js honour AUTOPILOT_SUBAGENT_BUDGET_NOW_MS; any other value (or unset) keeps the real clock.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_TEST_SUBAGENT_BUDGET_MUTANT
entries.note: Row name for the subagent-budget concurrency mutant oracle. Ignored unless AUTOPILOT_TEST_ALLOW_SUBAGENT_BUDGET_MUTANT is exactly 1. Not a user knob.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_TEST_ALLOW_SUBAGENT_BUDGET_MUTANT
entries.note: Set to exactly 1 before hooks/subagent-budget.js will honour AUTOPILOT_TEST_SUBAGENT_BUDGET_MUTANT. Any other value ignores the mutant name.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_DISCUSS_TIMEOUT
entries.summary: Timeout of a discuss dispatch.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_DISPATCH_MODEL_GUARD_MODE
entries.summary: Set to "off" to silence the reminder that a subagent dispatch must name a model and an Engine header.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_ENDPOINT_<NAME>_URL
entries.summary: Per-endpoint settings loaded from the endpoints env file: AUTOPILOT_ENDPOINT_<NAME>_URL and AUTOPILOT_ENDPOINT_<NAME>_TOKEN. An HTTP seat appears in the topology only when its URL is set.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_ENDPOINTS_ENV
entries.summary: Path of the endpoints env file (mode 600) that load-endpoints-env.sh reads.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_FOREMAN_GUARD_ADVISORY_EVERY
entries.summary: Environment override of foreman_guard.advisory_every.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_FOREMAN_GUARD_BASH_CAP
entries.summary: Environment override of foreman_guard.bash_cap.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_FOREMAN_GUARD_MODE
entries.summary: Environment override of foreman_guard.mode.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_FOREMAN_GUARD_RESERVE_CALLS
entries.summary: Environment override of foreman_guard.reserve_calls.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_FOREMAN_GUARD_ROLE_CAPS
entries.summary: Environment override of foreman_guard.role_caps as "foreman=40,worker=120,reviewer=120".

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_HANDOFF_INJECT
entries.summary: Set to "1" to enable the session snapshot injection (same as handoff_inject: true; either source enables it).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_HANDOFF_MIN_TOOL_CALLS
entries.summary: A session needs at least this many tool calls before a snapshot is written.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_HANDOFF_MIN_USER_TURNS
entries.summary: A session needs at least this many user turns before a snapshot is written.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_HANDOFF_TRANSCRIPT_CAP
entries.summary: Maximum transcript bytes the snapshot writer reads (16 MiB).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_HOOK_<STEM>
entries.summary: Per-hook switch from the environment; <STEM> is the hook file stem upper-cased with dashes as underscores (AUTOPILOT_HOOK_BRANCH_PROTECTION=1).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_HOOK_RESIDUE_AUTO_REAP
entries.summary: Set to 0, false, off or no to disable the automatic residue sweep hook.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_INTENT_CAPTURE
entries.summary: Set to "false" to stop the per-directory intent capture used for cross-session resume hints.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_LIVE_DIR
entries.summary: Overrides the directory for the live status files; an explicit value is an isolation request and is never replaced by a fallback.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_LOCALE
entries.summary: en or zh-TW; used when ui.locale is auto or absent.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_MERGE_TASK_STATUS
entries.summary: Set to "off" to stop merging task-status input into the band.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_MIN_REVIEWED_SEATS
entries.summary: Minimum seats that must have reviewed before a review loop or phase receipt passes (same grammar as --min-reviewed-seats).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_MINIMAX_BASE_URL
entries.summary: Base URL for the provider-native MiniMax endpoint.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_ORCH_EDIT_GATE_MODE
entries.summary: Environment override of orchestrator_edit_gate.mode.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_PRECOMPACT_STDOUT
entries.summary: Set to "0" to stop the PreCompact hook printing its guidance text for the summarizer.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_PROTECTED_BRANCHES
entries.summary: Branch-name pattern the opt-in branch-protection hook guards.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_QC_OUTCOME
entries.summary: Overrides outcome in qc-gate-config.md (off, warn, or block). off skips the outcome stage only.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_QUALIFICATION_OVERRIDE
entries.summary: A matching, unexpired override that lets a dispatch use a seat whose qualification would otherwise refuse it.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_RESIDUE_ARCHIVE_BRANCH_DAYS
entries.summary: Positive number; environment override of residue.archive_branch_days.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_RESIDUE_ARCHIVE_REMIND_DAYS
entries.summary: Positive number; environment override of residue.archive_remind_days.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_RESIDUE_AUTO_REAP
entries.summary: 0 or 1; environment override of residue.auto_reap.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_RESIDUE_LEASE_HOURS
entries.summary: Positive number; environment override of residue.lease_hours.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_RESIDUE_TMP_PRUNE
entries.summary: 0 or 1; environment override of residue.tmp_prune.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_REVIEW_SERVER_AUTOSTART
entries.summary: Set to "0" to stop the runs watcher from starting the review page server.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_REVIEW_MAX_CONCURRENCY
entries.summary: Most review seats that run at once in a review fan-out (qc panel, final panel); the rest queue in order and each seat's timeout starts when it actually starts. Unset, 0 or not a whole number means all seats at once.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_RUN_APPROVAL_MODE
entries.summary: Environment override of run_approval.mode; an unrecognised value means off.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_RUNS_WATCH_AUTOSTART
entries.summary: Set to "0" to stop sessions from starting the live runs watcher.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_RUNS_WATCH_IDLE_EXIT_S
entries.summary: Seconds of idleness before the runs watcher exits (positive integer).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_RUNS_WATCH_INTERVAL_S
entries.summary: Seconds between runs watcher polls (positive integer).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_SESSION_TASKS
entries.summary: Set to "off" to stop folding task-tool events into the live band.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_STRIKE_ENFORCEMENT
entries.summary: Set to "enforce" to arm strike-based requalification; otherwise strikes are only recorded.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_SUGGEST_COMPACT
entries.summary: Set to "false" to turn off the tool-call-count compaction nudge (suggest-compact hook).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_TMP_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
entries.summary: Days dispatch scripts keep their temp logs; 0 disables the prune.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_TOPOLOGY_FILE
entries.summary: Where the derived dispatch topology is written and read.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_UPDATE_CHECK
entries.summary: Set to "0" to stop the update notice (either this or update_check: false switches it off).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_CONFIG_PAIR_CHECK
entries.summary: Set to "0" to stop the ordinary-session reminder when context_budget.t2 plus gap is above autoCompactWindow minus 33000.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_PRICES_FETCH
entries.summary: Set to "0" to stop the SessionStart refresh of the seat price cache (either this or prices_fetch: false switches it off).

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_PRICES_CACHE_DIR
entries.summary: Where the seat price cache lives (never inside a git work tree); tests point it at a temp dir.

entries.name: .claude/backlog-config.md
entries.summary: Backlog entry schema options and pointer rule.

entries.name: .claude/debug-config.md
entries.summary: Project-specific debug tools and log paths.

entries.name: .claude/dev-flow-config.md
entries.summary: Size rules, quality gates, build commands, special rules.

entries.name: .claude/dispatch-config.md
entries.summary: Which dispatcher, reviewer and methodology autopilot delegates to when other plugins are installed.

entries.name: .claude/dispatch-guard-config.md
entries.summary: Per-project gate on expensive-model dispatch (dispatch-model-guard).

entries.name: .claude/doa-config.md
entries.summary: Delegated Operations Authority presets for subagent dispatch.

entries.name: .claude/doc-drift-config.md
entries.summary: Doc-to-code domains the doc-sync skill audits.

entries.name: .claude/execution-boundary-config.md
entries.summary: sanctioned_roots, protected refs and allow_sql for the opt-in exec-boundary hook.

entries.name: .claude/finish-flow-config.md
entries.summary: Closing-sequence overrides (merge target, archive procedure, per-size quality gate).

entries.name: .claude/knowledge-routing-config.md
entries.summary: Where durable knowledge lands (handoff, learn, distill).

entries.name: .claude/loop.md
entries.summary: Default prompt for a bare /loop.

entries.name: .claude/model-routing-config.md
entries.summary: Subagent model and mode per role.

entries.name: .claude/next-config.md
entries.summary: Work source paths for the next skill.

entries.name: .claude/owner-kernel-governance.json
entries.summary: Project governance: mission-convergence enforcement and budgets, guidance defaults, red lines, rosters (the file name is historical; the file is live).

entries.name: .claude/profiling-config.md
entries.summary: Profiling tools and metrics collection.

entries.name: .claude/project-lifecycle-config.md
entries.summary: Project paths and bootstrap/archive scripts.

entries.name: .claude/qc-gate-config.md
entries.summary: Strength of the QC forcing function at push and finish-flow.

entries.name: .claude/quality-gate-config.md
entries.summary: Test, scan and review commands.

entries.name: .claude/review-loop-config.md
entries.summary: Engine roster and loop policy of the heterogeneous review pipeline.

entries.name: .claude/skill-routing.md
entries.summary: Maps keywords to your project domain skills.

entries.name: .claude/task-class-config.md
entries.summary: Autonomous front-door routing and next-pick weighting.

entries.name: .claude/team-config.md
entries.summary: Team role templates for your tech stack.

entries.name: .claude/test-integrity-config.md
entries.summary: Mode and rules of the test-integrity gate.

entries.name: .claude/test-strategy-config.md
entries.summary: Test commands, pyramid ratios, coverage thresholds.

entries.name: .claude/worktree-teardown-config.md
entries.summary: Per-project cleanup seam for hetero worktrees.

entries.name: config_schema_version
entries.summary: The config.json format version you last reviewed (current: 1). Missing counts as 0. Autopilot never writes it; set it to the current number after reading the upgrade check, which then stops listing changes up to that number.

entries.name: T14_GATE_WRITE_EVIDENCE
entries.note: When set to 1, the t14 gate tests refresh docs/plans/evidence/2026-10-19-t14-gate-experiment/s*-red.txt. Default is unset, and the tests leave those files alone. Paths written into the transcripts use the placeholder /tmp/ORCH-GATE-TEST-TMP.

entries.name: AUTOPILOT_ROOMS_DIR
entries.note: Parent of per-room directories. Unset means $HOME/.autopilot/rooms. Read by scripts/lib/room-log.js.

entries.name: FLEET_LIFETIME
entries.note: Exported by child_session_mint to every claude child a rail launches. Always ephemeral; an inherited value is overridden, a child is never promoted to durable.

entries.name: FLEET_PARENT
entries.note: Exported by child_session_mint. An inherited FLEET_PARENT is kept, else the launching Claude Code session id.

entries.name: FLEET_ROLE
entries.note: Exported by child_session_mint, display only for fleet. review-seat for dispatch-review, hand for dispatch-author and dispatch-hetero, child when the caller gives none.

entries.name: ROUNDTABLE_FLEET_BIN
entries.note: Executable used for fleet send. Tests point it at a fake. Default is fleet.

entries.name: ROUNDTABLE_TMUX_BIN
entries.note: tmux binary for open. Tests inject a fake. Default is tmux.

entries.name: ROUNDTABLE_SEATS
entries.note: Comma-separated courier handles used when --seats is omitted. Else say-row senders other than owner and moderator.
